readme_head:
# 🏈 Oddsmith — Sportsbook & Sports Betting Platform

**Oddsmith** is a full-stack **online sportsbook** inspired by FanDuel. Browse live **NFL** and **NBA** lines, build a **betslip**, and place simulated wagers — with machine-learning **“best bet”** picks on every game.

> 🎲 Crafted odds. Smarter picks. A demo sports betting experience built for learning and portfolio use.

[![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-@toptrendev_66-2CA5E0?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram)](https://t.me/TopTrenDev_66)
[![Twitter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twitter-@toptrendev-1DA1F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=x)](https://x.com/intent/follow?screen_name=toptrendev)

---

## 🎯 What you can do

- 📊 **Sportsbook board** — spreads, moneylines, and totals (over/under) for upcoming games  
- 🧾 **Betslip** — add selections, set stakes, and submit bets in one flow  
- 🤖 **ML picks** — scikit-learn models flag the strongest edge per matchup  
- 💰 **Bankroll** — simulated deposit, withdraw, and balance tracking  
- 📜 **Bet history** — view open and settled wagers  
- 🔐 **Accounts** — sign up, log in, and manage your profile (JWT)

---

## 🛠 Tech stack

| Layer | Technologies |
|-------|----------------|
| Frontend | React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, MUI 6, Redux Toolkit 2, React Router 7 |
| Backend | Flask 3, Flask-JWT-Extended, APScheduler |
| Database | MongoDB (PyMongo) |
| ML | scikit-learn, pandas |

---

## 📋 Prerequisites

- **Node.js** 20+
- **Python** 3.11+
- **MongoDB** (local or Atlas)

---

## 🚀 Quick start

### 1. Backend

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv venv
# Windows
venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux
source venv/bin/activate

pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your MONGO_URI, SECRET_KEY, API_KEY, CRON_SECRET
flask run
```

API runs at `http://127.0.0.1:5000`.

### 2. Frontend (development)

```bash
cd frontend
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
cp .env.example .env
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:5173`. Vite proxies `/api` to the Flask backend.

### 3. Production build (single server)

```bash
cd frontend && npm run build
cd ../backend && flask run
```

Flask serves the built app from `frontend/dist`.

---

## ⚙️ Environment variables

### Backend (`backend/.env`)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `MONGO_URI` | MongoDB connection string |
| `MONGO_DB_NAME` | Database name (default: `db`) |
| `SECRET_KEY` | JWT signing secret (required) |
| `API_KEY` | [The Odds API](https://the-odds-api.com/) key |
| `CRON_SECRET` | Secret for scheduled game updates |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | Comma-separated allowed origins |

### Frontend (`frontend/.env`)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `VITE_API_URL` | API base URL (empty = same origin / dev proxy) |
| `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` | Optional, for signup address autocomplete |

## 📌 Notes

This is a **demo sportsbook** for education and development — not a licensed real-money gambling operator. Odds are sourced from live APIs and historical data; settlement runs on a schedule via protected cron jobs.
